# [Changelog 3.1.3](https://omega.gg/Sky/changes/3.1.3.html)

### Previous: [Changelog 3.1.2](3.1.2.html)

# [Sky kit](https://omega.gg/Sky)
---

## Overview

This release adds radius support and revised border behavior to SkyScrollBar, refines SkySlider
and BaseSlider handle geometry, and extends WPixmapCache with getPixmapArea alongside an svg
support fix. WControllerFile gains a fileName function and new Q_INVOKABLEs, and WFileWatcher and
WBashManager receive maintenance updates.


## SkCore

- WControllerFile: Create fileName function.

- WControllerFile: Add Q_INVOKABLE(s).

- WControllerFile: Update onLog function.

- WFileWatcher: Update.

- WBashManager: Update id implementation.


## SkGui

- WPixmapCache: Add getPixmapArea function.

- WPixmapCache: Fix getPixmap svg support.


## SkyBase

- BaseSlider: Update pApplyHandle.

- BaseSlider: Leave the handle alone on a range with no room.


## SkyComponents

- SkyScrollBar: Add radius support.

- SkyScrollBar: Update border behavior and add aliases.

- SkySlider: Update geometry.

- ButtonCheck: Update.

- StyleComponents: Add buttonPush_radius.


## Tools

- Update qmlGenerator.
